# 1.2.104 - The body stays where it fell and is announced on every screen; the player proposes the statistic and the GM approves, changes or refuses it on one card; Take from the Body rolls Hand, only the first roll for a Take counts, and a witness means a Shadow cover; one wide layout for every action; Breakdown and Wounded on the sheet, not the token

Stages E95 and E68 (E68 `with` E95), one train, built on one line from 1.2.103 (f31afc84). The range is
`v1.2.103..aad79b75`: 67 commits, 12 of them merges of the stages' own branches into the line, and the
last three (0f415b0a, e6c7186b, aad79b75) written after CI's green run on b84d1170 (Checked). In the owner's terms:

- **E95, the body on the map.** A murdered student who becomes a Monocub leaves a body tile where their token stood,
  captioned "{name}'s body" with the death sign; the room a body lies in is read in one place (`bodyRoomOf`), and the
  loot of a body is judged there; the body's public announcement calls one named hook, `drpgBodyAnnounced`, on every
  connected browser. With it, the owner's asks of 10.11.2026: Breakdown and Wounded drawn on no token and public on
  the sheet, a sheet button on every row of GM panel > Students, and no Inventory tab on a Monokuma's sheet.
- **E68, the statistic rule.** Wherever a roll lists several statistics the player proposes one (and may say how) and
  a GM answers on one card in the player's thread: **Approve: {stat}**, **Change to: {stat}** or **Refuse**. The
  killer's opening proposes too. Search rolls on six statistics (Eye asks nobody), Stage 6's clean-up on Shadow,
  Resolve costs 2 Hope and asks nobody. **Take from the Body** rolls Hand: the roll says how plain the body's one
  Remnant reads, every Take rolls, only the first roll thrown for that Take counts, and with a witness in the room the
  Take waits for a Shadow cover roll. The crisis menu and the murder roads read the proposal. **One layout for every
  action**: the briefing on the left, the question on the right, in one wide window; Observe no longer scrolls. And
  the fix round after the end review.

Nothing in this version ran at a real table or on a Foundry server; what was measured was measured headless and in
Chromium on the module's own harness pages. Below, an R number or a "tier 2" test names one of the module's own
tests (`game.drpg.runTests()`), and a scenario one of the headless harness's multi-browser runs. It is published as a
full release (latest), never a prerelease (the
owner's rule). The gaps are in Known gaps and Checked.

## Before installing

- **No world migration**: `scripts/migrate.mjs` is unchanged since 1.2.103 and no flag is renamed. Back up the world
  as before any update.
- **One new world setting**, off by default: **Approve statistic proposals in Daily Life automatically** (PL
  "Zatwierdzaj propozycje statystyk w Daily Life automatycznie"). On, a player's proposed statistic for a Search or a
  project without a statistic is approved with no GM's press, in Daily Life, outside an Eclipse and an incident; fights,
  openings and Dynamic actions still ask a GM.
- **One new GM store**, "lootRolls" (the first roll of each Take; shared between the GMs' browsers, not in the case
  backup, cleared with the reset's "Deaths and Monocubs" group). Nothing to do.
- **A student who was already a Monocub** before this version has no body tile: the tile is laid when Monocub is
  ticked, and until then their body is searched beside the token, as before. Ticking Monocub off and on again lays it
  where the Monocub's token stands at that moment (read in the code, not tried at a table).
- **Resolve now costs 2 Hope**, not 3. Breakdown's and Wounded's icons are no longer drawn on any token, for anybody;
  both show on the sheet.
- `tools/stages.json`: E95 declares `touches` ["scenes"], E68 ["sockets", "rolls", "scenes"] (e6c7186b), so the local
  gate is required for this version (Checked).
- **Daggerheart**: the system's releases page lists 2.12.8, dated 11 Nov (looked up on 11.11.2026). `module.json`
  keeps `verified` 2.6.5 (the release rule: `verified` names only a version the suite has passed on at a real table)
  and states no `maximum` (decision D1), so 2.12.8 loads and the module warns the GM once per version. Foundry:
  `verified` 14.365, unchanged.

## Take from the Body (E68 C10 21d4d1fe, 18d7c470, b51d2a13, 691d707a)

## Known gaps

- **A Shadow roll can tell a player someone is there.** The GMs' count of the room decides whether a Take needs a
  Shadow cover (it counts a Monocub, and tokens only the GMs place). A player whose screen shows nobody can be asked for
  a Shadow roll, which tells them a watcher is counted.
- **A GM's own Take button** keeps the GM's roll; the first-roll rule binds a player's Take only.
- **Take from the Body is still the body's list** on the sheet's Inventory pane (a tick per row, Take the ticked), not
  a window on the new layout. Stage 6's failure card keeps its readers as before (the roller's view of the room).
- **A pass after Change to** is one line in the player's thread, not on the GM's card, which already says "Answered by
  {name}." The killer gets no pass on the murder card: a changed statistic is the GM's word.
- **The killer's accomplice** in the room: whether they count as a witness for the Shadow cover and get the miss card
  is not settled by the harness (LIVE-E68-03 item 4); a GM can meet it at the table.
- **The opening's proposal** reaches the first opening invitation only; the tracker's "Ask for the opening roll
  again" asks with none.
- **D023's readings**, on the owner's default: the new target is offered from the project's room, not where the builder
  stands at the press; the done card is not posted again; "the GM who asked" is every GM.
- **A body tile the GM deletes** is laid again where the Monocub then stands if Monocub is ticked again (RV-2, kept):
  delete it only to take the body away. Two GMs at once can lay two tiles (the earliest counts, both are captioned, a
  revive removes both); the race itself was not driven.
- **Until E72**, two Monocubs can still announce a body, and `drpgBodyAnnounced` fires for it (E95 Q9).
- **A body announced while a page loads** over a slow link, more than 60 s before its `ready`, is not announced on
  that page (the 60 s chosen, not measured).
- **The sheet**: the badge row and Health and Sanity in one row were measured on a model of Daggerheart's sidebar, not
  its stylesheet. On the comparison's stand-in (11.11.2026) the two badges read run together, "BreakdownWounded", and
  Health and Sanity stack; a Monokuma's Despair Calls tiles' labels are cut at 1366x768. A real sheet will tell.
  Unchanged, the owner may ask: a roll's card still names the extra die "Disadvantage", the Party sheet has no badge,
  the token HUD's status list is as before.
- **Older Polish handbook sentences** still say "na karcie" for the sheet in places; the new text says "arkusz".
- **The Palm window** (Frisk's ways under the rows) was not captured in Chromium: its layout is not seen. The fit
  sweep reads each window's default pick only, and the crisis menu's brush pair comes from the mockup page, not a
  capture (an incident has no capture).
- **Not done from E68's questions**: Q6's before/after numbers for the balance log as a dated AUDIT row are not
  written, and Q7's headless click count is in no scenario (LIVE-E68-05 says so).
- **The live checks** (AUDIT 9.2), not yet done at a real table: LIVE-E95-01 the body tile's picture, sign and caption,
  02 the tile's units and floors on v14, 03 `drpgBodyAnnounced` on a real server, 04 a hidden body tile in a player's
  browser, 05 no state icon on any token and both states on the sheet; LIVE-E68-01 the opening's proposal at a murder
  declaration, a betrayal and a trap, 02 Resolve for 2 Hope and Stage 6 on Shadow with no card, 03 Take from the Body
  with a witness and with an accomplice, the Remnant at the tile, 04 the action layout at 1366x768 in both themes under
  Foundry's stylesheet, Observe with no scroll, 05 Search's and Dynamic's clicks at a session.
